ABOUT MICROBAC Microbac Laboratories, Inc . is a premier commercial laboratory testing firm that partners with clients nationwide, offering laboratory solutions to life science, food and nutrition, and environmental industries and serves our clients with the utmost expertise and respect for their market requirements, constraints, and challenges.

We embody a company-wide commitment to exceptional customer experience, which has been refined by over 50 years of trusted, analytical and measurement experience. As a privately held third-party testing company, Microbac operates with a commitment to our workforce, safety, quality, and compliance.

Our diverse work portfolio includes broad accreditation offerings and tested insights across the environmental, food and nutrition and life science markets.

JOB SUMMARY The Payroll Administrator/Staff Accountant evaluates and manages the payroll practices at Microbac, ensuring accurate employee compensation, tax withholdings, and deductions in compliance with federal, state and local regulations. This role is also responsible for providing support for balance sheet reconciliation for the Finance team.

Essential Functions: Create efficiencies and improve processes for payroll practices, utilization of ADP Essential Time, and tax compliance. With the utilization of ADP SmartCompliance, manage federal, state, and local tax withholdings, social security, and unemployment insurance.

Monitor and maintain consistent processes for monitoring and reviewing tax compliance and filings. Provide reports and data analysis for payroll cycles identifying with any discrepancies and/or adjustments creating inconsistency in numbers.

Assist senior leaders with analyzing data and providing information relating to overtime, vacation payout liabilities, and inconsistencies with recording of time and attendance or paid time off management.

Collaborate and have strong lines of communication with Human Resources on people moves, promotions, salary adjustments, new hires, terminations, discrepancies in payroll, etc. Process bi-weekly payroll, distribute payroll reports, and execute and meet deadlines on all year-end processes as it relates to payroll and tax.

Maintain confidentiality and discretion with sensitive employee salary and personal information. Assist with projects and initiatives as needed. Minimum Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, or a related field or at least 5 years of managing payroll processes with the utilization of ADP Essential Time.

Certified Payroll Professional (CPP) preferred. Advanced software proficiency with ADP Essential Time and Certinia, or another cloud-based business management platform that combines financial management, professional services automation, and enterprise resource planning tools.

Expert skill level in Microsoft Office, especially Excel and Outlook, and intermediate skill level with Teams and PowerPoint. Strong knowledge and continuous education on the regulations for labor laws and state regulations for payroll and exiting employee pay requirements. Experience with managing and reconciling balance sheets.

Effective and articulate verbal and written communication skills. Strong organizational skills and ability to multi-task in a fast-paced environment. Strong attention to detail for reconciling payroll, reports, and audits.

In addition, the successful candidate will have: A commitment and aspiration to positively accept and impact a culture of accountability, appreciation and respect. Eagerness to provide exceptional services and deliverables to the corporate and operations teams at Microbac.

A strong customer service mindset with the ability to manage inquiries and execute transactional work in a timely and efficient manner. An eagerness to adapt to change, create efficiencies, find resolution to issues, and utilize resources to provide accurate responses.

Manage Transition Service Agreements (TSAs) associated with each acquisition: track all services in scope, ensure invoices are received and remittances are made accurately and on time, and coordinate wind-down of TSA services as integration milestones are reached.

Adyen is looking for a General Ledger Accountant to join our Group Finance team in Amsterdam. In this role, you aren’t just "processing numbers" , you are the engine behind our Record-to-Report (R2R) cycle for Operational Expenses. You will act as the critical link between business operations and financial data, ensuring that as Adyen scales, our financial integrity remains rock-solid.
You will move beyond simple data entry to maintain a holistic "risk mindset," proactively identifying vulnerabilities and anomalies before they ever hit a report. Being part of a centralized Finance Operations team means you’ll be working in the engine room of a listed financial institution, where your work directly impacts our global trial balance.

R2R Ownership: Act as the detail layer for Operational Expenses, owning the accuracy of GL bookings and ensuring a clean Trial Balance.
Accounting Control: Apply rigorous controls to the P2P and R2R cycle. You’ll validate data flowing from FinOps, manage supplier accruals, and reconcile prepaid assets.
High-Value Oversight: Act as the financial gatekeeper for high-value transactions, performing due diligence to ensure accuracy and relieving Financial Controllers of transactional approvals.
Risk & Anomaly Detection: Regularly review the full ledger to detect trends or vulnerabilities, acting as the first line of defense for data integrity.
Asset & Lease Management: Manage the Fixed Asset Register, including capitalization, depreciation, and executing lease accounting (IFRS 16) entries.
Intercompany & Reporting: Manage intercompany bookings and reconciliations, perform month-end variance analysis to validate OpEx trends, and support internal/external audits.

Experienced: You have a solid background with at least three years of experience in GL accounting, specifically within P2P cycles and R2R processes.
Detail-Oriented & Analytical: You are passionate about balance sheet integrity and "getting it right the first time.
Collaborative: You enjoy working with multiple stakeholders, from FinOps to various stakeholders such as Controllers and Tax lawyers, to ensure smooth financial reporting.
Proactive: You question the status quo and look for ways to automate or improve processes as we grow.
Adaptable: You can manage multiple projects, from IFRS 16 lease entries to intercompany reconciliations, without losing focus.

All applicants are required to have one of the following basic education requirements. Education: A degree in Accounting; or a degree in a related field such as business administration, finance, or public administration that included or was supplemented by 24 semester hours in accounting.
